passage.label: By sun brightness; moon follows it; day displays it; night covers it; sky He constructed it; earth He spread it; soul He proportioned it; inspired wickedness righteousness; succeeded purifies it; failed instills corruption

mainSubject.label: Eleven oaths by the sun and its brightness, the moon following it, the day displaying it, the night covering it, the sky and its Constructor, the earth and its Spreader, and the soul and its Proportioner who inspired it with discernment of wickedness and righteousness — establishing that whoever purifies the soul succeeds while whoever corrupts it fails

subordinateSubjects.label: Oath sworn by the sun and its brightness
And by the moon when it follows the sun
And by the day when it displays the sun's light
And by the night when it covers the sun
And by the sky and He who constructed it
And by the earth and He who spread it
And by the soul and He who proportioned it
Inspiring it with discernment of its wickedness and righteousness
Success belongs to whoever purifies the soul
Failure belongs to whoever instils it with corruption

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Soul proportioned and inspired with moral discernment between wickedness and righteousness
Success tied to self-purification and failure to self-corruption

relationships.label: Sun-moon-day-night quadruple oath establishing cosmic rhythm
Sky construction and earth spreading sworn by alongside the soul's proportioning

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the purification-success/corruption-failure binary (10) before the Thamud precedent opens (11); P2 runs through the five-verse narrative of transgression, the she-camel warning, hamstringing, levelled destruction and divine fearlessness (11-15).
